title: Life Framework owner config
description: The owner's $profile:LifeFramework/config.json. Generated by tools/config/schema.mjs from the config classes' [Attribute] declarations; do not edit by hand.

schemaVersion.description: Owner file schema version. A file without it is version 1.

catalogue.description: The item catalogue and its outlets: Configs/Catalogue/LF_ItemCatalogue.conf, then each pack overlay of this class (D4), then the owner's `catalogue` section, then (on a client) the server's streamed values.

items.description: Catalogue items, keyed by id. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is the item id (pistol_m9, raincoat_green). An id no shipped item has adds one, which must set prefab; an existing id changes only the fields given. removed: true takes the item out of every outlet; a later layer can put it back with removed: false.

op.description: Overlay verb for this id: add, replace, patch or remove. Empty patches an id that exists and adds one that does not (docs/config/override-model.md).

prefab.description: The item's prefab, a {GUID}path. Never a DLC-owned prefab

category.description: Category: weapon, ammo, clothing, equipment or tool

price.description: Price a buyer pays at an outlet

sellPrice.description: Price an outlet pays a seller. Never above the price

legality.description: Legality: legal, licensed (lawful with the licence), restricted (lawful only with the licence, e.g. police kit) or illegal

licence.description: Licence (LF_ELicenseType name) that makes carrying a licensed or restricted item lawful, e.g. FIREARM_PERMIT

concealsFace.description: Clothing: hides the wearer's face from a witness

concealsBuild.description: Clothing: hides the wearer's build from a witness

removed.description: Hidden: no outlet sells it; a later layer can set it back. The remove verb takes the item out of the list instead

offers.description: Outlet offers, keyed by outlet/item: which counter sells which item behind which gate. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is outlet/item (gun_counter/pistol_m9): the outlet id a shop counter names, a slash, and the catalogue item id. A new key adds the offer; an existing key changes only the gate fields given. removed: true takes the item off that outlet.

op.description: Overlay verb for this id: add, replace, patch or remove. Empty patches an id that exists and adds one that does not (docs/config/override-model.md).

licence.description: Gate: licence the buyer must hold (LF_ELicenseType name). Empty is no licence gate

job.description: Gate: job the buyer must be in (POLICE is an on-duty officer and the rank is the police rank; any other id is an LF_EJobType name the buyer works now and the rank is the job level). Empty is no job gate

minRank.description: Gate with the job: the lowest rank (police rank index, or job level) that may buy

orgRight.description: Gate: organisation right the buyer's rank must carry (LF_EOrganizationPermission name). Empty is no right gate

stock.description: Stock: units the outlet holds of this item. 0 is no limit. A sale beyond what is left is refused (out of stock); server memory only, so a restart refills it

restockSeconds.description: Restock: seconds after the first sale from a full shelf until the shelf is full again. 0 is no restock until the server restarts

removed.description: Hidden: the outlet no longer sells the item; a later layer can set it back. The remove verb takes the offer out of the list instead

cleanup.description: The cleanup config: Configs/World/LF_CleanupConfig.conf with the owner's cleanup section over it.

sweepIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between sweeps. 0 turns the sweep off

rules.description: One rule per kind. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is the kind: item, vehicle or body. A kind the shipped config has not listed adds a rule.

maxAgeSeconds.description: Seconds an entity must have gone without a player near it before it goes

minPlayerDistance.description: Metres to the nearest player; a closer entity is kept and its age starts over

maxHealthPercent.description: Health percent at or below which an entity may go. 100 sweeps any damage state

exemptPrefabs.description: Prefab name parts that are never swept

crime.description: The crime catalog config: Configs/Crime/LF_CrimeCatalog.conf, with the owner's `crime` section layered over it.

crimes.description: Offences, in order. The ticket form lists the ones with a fine in this order. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is the crime id, a localization key such as #LF-Offence_Robbery; saved crime records use the same string. An id no shipped entry has adds an offence at the end; an existing id changes only the fields given.

op.description: Overlay verb for this id: add, replace, patch or remove. Empty patches an id that exists and adds one that does not (docs/config/override-model.md).

wantedAdd.description: Wanted levels the crime adds when it is committed. Wanted caps at 5

fine.description: Fixed fine in cash. Above 0 the offence is listed on the officer's ticket form, in catalog order

sentenceSeconds.description: Jail time in seconds when this offence is on the prisoner's reports. 0 leaves the sentence to the wanted level; otherwise the longer of the two applies

repeatThreshold.description: Completed crimes of this kind after which a repeat adds wanted levels. 0 turns the repeat rule off

repeatWantedAdd.description: Extra wanted levels a repeat adds on top of the normal amount

dayCycle.description: The `dayCycle` owner section (M4, #1343): how fast the in-game clock runs.

mode.description: How the in-game clock runs: vanilla (the base game's), accelerated (a day lasts dayLengthMinutes real minutes) or realtime (follows the real clock plus clockOffsetMinutes)

dayLengthMinutes.description: Real minutes one in-game day lasts under accelerated mode. Ignored by the other modes

nightSpeed.description: Not supported (#1650): the vanilla time manager has one day duration and no night rate, so a value other than 1 logs a Warn and the night runs at the day's rate. Kept so old configs still load

startHour.description: The in-game hour a fresh world starts at

clockOffsetMinutes.description: Minutes added to the in-game clock

disconnect.description: Disconnect rules: what logging out does to a player who is cuffed, escorted, downed, wanted or jailed, so leaving never escapes an arrest, a death or a sentence.

cuffedRule.description: Logging out while cuffed: jail (the rejoin spawns in the cell), fine (taken from the bank) or release (only the cuffs come off)

escortedCountsAsCuffed.description: A player escorted on foot by an officer counts as cuffed

cuffedWantedAdd.description: Wanted levels added for leaving custody (jail and fine rules)

cuffedMinJailSeconds.description: Shortest sentence in seconds for leaving custody under the jail rule

cuffedFine.description: Fine taken from the bank for leaving custody under the fine rule

cuffedFineAllowsDebt.description: The fine may take the bank below zero (debt). Off: only what the bank holds

downedDies.description: Logging out while downed is death. Off: the body is left to the base game, and the rejoin is alive

wantedLogoutAdd.description: Wanted levels added for logging out while wanted and not in custody. The warrant itself always stays

jailClockOffline.description: A jail sentence counts down while the prisoner is offline. Off: only online time is served

idCard.description: The photo identity card: Configs/Identity/LF_PhotoIdCard.conf with the owner's `idCard` section layered over it.

replacementFee.description: Cash the town clerk charges for a replacement identity card (a lost or stolen one). 0 replaces it free

showSeconds.description: Seconds a card held up to another player (Show ID, a police request) stays on their screen

jobs.description: Job pay, job XP and job levels.

policeDutyPayPerSecond.description: Police duty pay in cash per second on duty, paid at the station desk on going off duty. 0 disables duty pay

medicDutyPayPerSecond.description: Medic duty pay in cash per second on duty, paid at the hospital desk on going off duty. 0 disables duty pay

benefitBalanceThreshold.description: Unemployment benefit: a bank balance strictly below this may collect

benefitAmount.description: Unemployment benefit: cash handed over per collection. 0 disables the benefit

benefitCooldownSeconds.description: Unemployment benefit: seconds between collections for one account

jobXpFirstLevel.description: Delivery career before job tracks: XP from level 1 to 2. Read only to migrate a version 7-27 save's career onto the DELIVERY job; set it to what this server used

jobXpLevelGrowth.description: Delivery career before job tracks: each later level needed this many times the XP of the one before. Read only to migrate a version 7-27 save

testUnlockAll.description: TESTING ONLY, never on a live server. Opens every whitelist-gated job (police roster, playtime, application) to every player so a tester can clock in. A dedicated server ignores it unless the mission header allows it; the flagship config must not set it

tracks.description: Job level ladders: the XP thresholds of each job. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is the job id (CIVILIAN, DELIVERY, FARMER, ...). A job no shipped track has adds one, which must set levelThresholds; an existing key changes only the fields given. The level is 1 plus the thresholds a character's XP has reached, so a changed table reaches existing saves.

op.description: Overlay verb for this id: add, replace, patch or remove. Empty patches an id that exists and adds one that does not (docs/config/override-model.md).

levelThresholds.description: Total XP to reach level 2, 3, ... in rising order; the level is 1 plus the thresholds reached

dailyXpCap.description: Most XP one character earns in this job per day of server time (24 h since boot); 0 for no cap

xpAwards.description: XP each in-world action awards, the job it feeds and its cooldown. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is the action id the game awards (delivery_run, fruit_pick, gather). An action no shipped award has adds one, which must set job; an existing key changes only the fields given.

op.description: Overlay verb for this id: add, replace, patch or remove. Empty patches an id that exists and adds one that does not (docs/config/override-model.md).

job.description: Job id the XP goes to

xp.description: XP for one unit of the action (one run, one fruit)

cooldownSeconds.description: Seconds before the same character earns this action's XP again; 0 for none

licenceGates.description: Licence gates that differ from the shipped catalog: the job and level a licence needs. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is a licence name (LF_ELicenseType, e.g. MINER_GOLD). A licence with no row keeps its shipped gate (its family job, its catalog level); a new row must set job and minLevel.

op.description: Overlay verb for this id: add, replace, patch or remove. Empty patches an id that exists and adds one that does not (docs/config/override-model.md).

job.description: Job id whose level the licence needs

joinNotice.description: The `joinNotice` owner section: one toast at each player's first spawn of the session.

enabled.description: Show the join notice toast at each player's first spawn of the session. Off in the core

key.description: Localization key of the notice text, with or without the leading #. Empty shows nothing and logs a warning

licences.description: The owner's `licences` section (D8): which licences a new character starts with and which need the job whitelist.

rules.description: Per-licence flags, keyed by licence name. A licence with no row keeps the catalog's flags. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is a licence name as LF_ELicenseType spells it (POLICE_ACCESS, MINER_GOLD, ...). A name that is not a licence is refused. The job level a licence needs is jobs.licenceGates.

op.description: Overlay verb for this id: add, replace, patch or remove. Empty patches an id that exists and adds one that does not (docs/config/override-model.md).

isInitialLicense.description: Granted free when a character starts with no licences

requiresWhitelist.description: Needs the job whitelist before it can be unlocked

organizations.description: Organization tuning: the founding fee, name length, offer lifetime, fund cash limit, upgrade prices and the desk reach.

foundingFee.description: Carried cash the founder hands over at the registry desk to found an organization

offerMs.description: Milliseconds an invitation stands before the invitee has to be asked again

maxCashMove.description: Largest single cash move into or out of an organization fund

priceExtraStorage.description: Fund price of the extra storage upgrade

priceProcessingSlot.description: Fund price of the processing slot upgrade

priceParkedVehicle.description: Fund price of the parked vehicle upgrade

deskRange.description: Metres a player may stand from an organization desk when the server moves fund cash

heldGroundMaxPoints.description: Most points an organization banks by holding its hideout (#751); a saved total above it is clamped on load

rankDefaults.description: Rights of the default ranks a new organization starts with, one entry per rank id (founder, officer, member). A rank with no entry keeps its shipped rights. Applies to organizations founded after the change; a saved organization keeps its own ranks. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is a default rank id: founder, officer or member. The entry starts from the shipped rights, so only the permissions written change. It applies to organizations founded afterwards; a saved organization keeps its own ranks.

op.description: Overlay verb for this id: add, replace, patch or remove. Empty patches an id that exists and adds one that does not (docs/config/override-model.md).

withdraw.description: May take cash out of the fund

kick.description: May kick members below this rank

buyUpgrade.description: May buy upgrades from the fund

manageRanks.description: May promote and demote members below this rank

declareWar.description: Reserved for the war record: no effect yet

useStash.description: Reserved: the hideout stash opens for every member today

manageTerritory.description: Reserved for territory: no effect yet

spendFund.description: Reserved: spending the fund on something other than an upgrade

persistence.description: The owner's `persistence` section: how the autosave runs, and which fields survive a restart.

enableAutosave.description: Save the campaign periodically while it runs. Off leaves saving to the save points and the shutdown save

keepCash.description: Cash on hand survives a restart. Off: carried cash is gone after a restart; the bank is kept

keepCarriedGear.description: Carried gear survives a restart. Off: a character respawns with the starting loadout, cash on hand included

keepSurvival.description: Hunger and thirst survive a restart. Off: both start full

keepWanted.description: Wanted levels survive a restart. Off: every warrant is cleared and its poster comes down

keepJail.description: Jail sentences survive a restart. Off: every prisoner is free after a restart

keepLicences.description: Earned licences survive a restart. Off: characters keep only the starter licences

police.description: Police tuning: per-rank permissions, the wanted board and crime reports, and the paper ticket: offences with fixed amounts, both deadlines, and the late rule.

arrestMinRank.description: Lowest police rank that may arrest (0 patrol, 1 senior)

escortMinRank.description: Lowest police rank that may escort a suspect (0 patrol, 1 senior)

ranks.description: The rank ladder, lowest first. A rank is its index here and a saved index never changes meaning: append, never reorder. Index 0 is patrol and 1 is senior. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is the rank id (patrol, senior). An id the ladder has changes that rank only in the fields given; an id it lacks appends a rung at the end, because a saved rank is its index and never moves. A remove is refused on a shipped rank and on any rank that is not the last. A rank written in the stream leaves out kit.

op.description: Overlay verb for this id: add, replace, patch or remove. Empty patches an id that exists and adds one that does not (docs/config/override-model.md).

titleKey.description: Localization key of the title, without the leading #

fineCap.description: Largest fine an officer of this rank may write

payPerSecond.description: Cash per on-duty second at clock-out. Negative uses the jobs config police rate

dutySecondsForNext.description: On-duty seconds that promote an officer to the next rank. 0 means no time promotion

kit.description: Kit prefabs drawn at the armory. Only prefabs in the station catalog are issued

alarmKinds.description: The site alarms by robbery type: each kind names the alarm prefab that sounds at the site (a bank bell, a till buzzer), a loud twin for when nobody is on duty, and the offences that use it when the robbed thing names no kind itself. A site with no kind keeps the plain siren above. Shipped values only; the owner config does not override kinds. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is the alarm kind id (bank, fuel, store, van), the id a robbed thing's alarm kind names. An id no shipped kind has adds one, which must set prefab; an existing id changes only the fields given. offences replaces the kind's offence list.

prefab.description: Alarm spawned at the site when officers are on duty

loudPrefab.description: Alarm spawned when nobody is on duty. Empty uses the normal prefab

offences.description: Offence keys (localization keys) that use this kind when the robbed thing names none

catchInActRadius.description: An on-duty officer this close (metres) when a crime is committed catches the suspect in the act: the report is identified at once

placeRadius.description: A crime report names the nearest sign within this many metres as the place; beyond it the place is a map grid square

boardReadDistance.description: How close (metres) a player must stand to the wanted board for the server to answer a read

boardMaxPosters.description: Most posters the wanted board shows, newest first

alarmSeconds.description: Seconds the site alarm sounds when at least one officer is on duty

loudAlarmSeconds.description: Seconds the site alarm sounds when nobody is on duty: the louder, longer alarm

alarmPrefab.description: Alarm spawned at the site when officers are on duty. Its LF_SiteAlarmComponent sets the sound, hear range, and light

loudAlarmPrefab.description: Alarm spawned at the site when nobody is on duty: the loud siren, a longer range, a brighter flashing light

radioSoundProject.description: Sound project of the radio chirp an on-duty officer hears with a dispatch

radioSoundEvent.description: Sound event of the radio chirp

dispatchLogLines.description: Dispatch lines the wanted board shows to on-duty police, newest first

ticketFirstDeadline.description: Online seconds a ticket holder has to pay at the police desk before the amount goes up

ticketSecondDeadline.description: Further online seconds after the first deadline before an unpaid ticket makes the holder wanted

ticketLateMultiplier.description: The amount is multiplied by this once, at the first deadline

officerKillOfWantedExempt.description: An on-duty officer who kills a suspect with wanted above 0 is not charged with murder

searchCooldownSeconds.description: Seconds before the same player or vehicle can be searched for chain goods again. A repeat inside it is not rolled again. 0 disables

ticketMaxOpen.description: Unpaid tickets one holder may carry; a further ticket is refused

ticketKeepPaid.description: Paid tickets kept per holder so a receipt reprints after a restart

arrestReach.description: Metres an officer may stand from a suspect to arrest or fine from the police menu or the arrest action

jailArrivalRadius.description: Metres from the cell a jail escort counts as arrived

applyDeskRange.description: Metres a player may stand from the police application desk for the form to open

compliantSeconds.description: Seconds after a hold-up during which the held-up player, holding no weapon, may be handcuffed by an on-duty officer. A downed player may always be. 0 allows downed players only

spikeStripLifetimeSeconds.description: Seconds a deployed spike strip stays before it goes away by itself. An officer can pick it up sooner

applyMinPlaytimeHours.description: Hours of play (all jobs together) an account needs before it may apply to the police. 0 turns the gate off

applyRejectCooldownHours.description: Hours an applicant waits to apply again after a rejection. 0 turns the cooldown off

trialHours.description: Hours a new officer is on trial after an approval. The roster entry ends when the trial does unless the officer was promoted first. 0 means no trial

restarts.description: The `restarts` owner section (M4, #1343): when the server restarts each day and how far ahead players are warned.

times.description: Daily restart times, 24-hour HH:MM in the server's local time (for example 04:00). Empty means no scheduled restarts

warningMinutes.description: Minutes before a restart at which players are warned, each 1 to 120. The shipped leads are 15, 5 and 1

rulesQuiz.description: The rules orientation quiz switches: Configs/Rules/LF_Quiz.conf, then each pack overlay of this class, then the owner's `rulesQuiz` section.

enabled.description: Ask new players the rules quiz. Off lets everyone through

repeatOnConnect.description: Ask on every connect, not once per account. The pass is still remembered for the staff tools

passPercent.description: Percent of the questions that must be right to pass

maxAttempts.description: Failed attempts before the player is kicked. 0 lets them retry for ever

shops.description: Price table for the shop system.

defaultBuyPrice.description: Default buy price when no rule matches

defaultSellPrice.description: Default sell price when no rule matches

priceRules.description: Ordered price rules; later matches override earlier ones. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The rule's key is a prefab-path substring, or type:<flags>,mode:<mode> to match by arsenal type (mode defaults to 2, any). A key no shipped rule has adds a rule; an existing key changes only the fields given.

op.description: Overlay verb for this id: add, replace, patch or remove. Empty patches an id that exists and adds one that does not (docs/config/override-model.md).

prefab.description: One prefab, matched by GUID; wins over the path substring and type/mode

buyPrice.description: Buy price: what the player pays

sellPrice.description: Sell price: what the shop pays the player

hidden.description: Never offer this item in any shop

extraItemPrefabs.description: Extra item prefabs priced outside the entity catalog

staff.description: The `staff` owner section (M4, #1343): where staff notifications are posted.

webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL staff notifications are posted to. A secret: set it only in the host's own config.json. Empty means no notifications

systems.description: The `systems` section: which systems this server runs.

switches.description: On or off per system, keyed by system id. Turning a system off keeps its saved data, so turning it on again restores it. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is a system id: a Feature/<Area> folder name (Farming) or a named part of one (Robbery, Pager), as Configs/Systems/LF_SystemCatalog.conf lists them. Turning a system off hides its actions, refuses its requests and spawns nothing; its saved data is kept, so turning it on again restores it. A framework system (LOCKED), a system with no switch yet (NOT_YET), and turning off one that an enabled system needs are refused at boot, and the system stays on.

enabled.description: On. Off hides the system's actions, refuses its requests and spawns nothing; its saved data is kept

buyPercent.description: Percent of the base price the lot charges

sellBackPercent.description: Percent of the base price a sell-back pays (no desk consumes it yet)

chopPercent.description: Percent of the (capped) base price the chop shop pays

chopValueCap.description: The chop shop counts no vehicle for more than this; 0 for no cap

impoundPercent.description: Percent of the base price the impound desk charges

garagePercent.description: Percent of the base price a garage charges (free today)

vehicles.description: Per-vehicle base prices and overrides. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is the vehicle's prefab GUID (16 hex digits, the lot's vanilla car or its locked child). A GUID no shipped vehicle has adds one, which must set basePrice. An existing key changes only the fields given; an override of -1 derives the price.

op.description: Overlay verb for this id: add, replace, patch or remove. Empty patches an id that exists and adds one that does not (docs/config/override-model.md).

spawnPrefab.description: Locked child the buyer gets (the chop shop and impound see this one). Empty: none

basePrice.description: The one number: what the vehicle is worth

wantedBoard.description: The posters drawn on the wanted board's face (docs/architecture/visual-boards-budget.md): Configs/Police/LF_WantedPosters.conf with the owner's `wantedBoard` section layered over it.

posters.description: Posters on the wanted board's face, newest first: one row up to 4, two rows up to 8. Each picture costs the viewer a few ms for 3 s after a change (docs/architecture/visual-boards-budget.md)

stolenPosters.description: How many of those places reported stolen cars may take, newest first, after the wanted people. 0 keeps stolen cars off the face (they stay on the officers' Read card)

drawRadius.description: Metres from the board within which a player's game draws the posters; beyond it plus 5 m they are released

zones.description: The zone rule sets: Configs/Moderation/LF_Zones.conf with the owner's `zones` section layered over it.

ruleSets.description: One entry per rule: what that rule does. Records are an object keyed by a stable key. The key is the rule name: NORMAL, SAFE or LAWLESS. A rule changes only the fields given. A rule with no shipped entry starts from what the two legacy flags say.

op.description: Overlay verb for this id: add, replace, patch or remove. Empty patches an id that exists and adds one that does not (docs/config/override-model.md).

blocksPlayerDamage.description: Player-on-player damage is refused when either side stands inside

suppressesWanted.description: A murder inside raises no wanted level

allowsWeaponDraw.description: Drawing a weapon is allowed inside

fineMultiplier.description: Multiplier on fines for crimes committed inside

copsEnter.description: Police may enter and act inside

safeBlocksPlayerDamage.description: Legacy: SAFE zones refuse player-on-player damage. Ignored once the rule table has a SAFE entry

lawlessSuppressesWanted.description: Legacy: a murder inside a LAWLESS zone raises no wanted level. Ignored once the rule table has a LAWLESS entry

everon1989.description: Pack LF_Everon1989: Settings of the 1989 Everon pack. A sample section: the owner's config.json can set it, but nothing reads it yet (the M5 chains will).

festivalDay.description: Day of the week the harbour festival runs, 1 to 7.

harbourName.description: The harbour town name the pack uses in announcements.

chainsEnabled.description: Whether the pack turns its resource chains on.
